overall_goal: Divide the chocolate batter into ramekins, bake them in the oven, and unmold them onto plates for serving.

goals.description: Prepare the workspace and clean the spatula
goals.rationale: The person clears space, moves the ramekins closer, and scrapes excess mixture off the spatula before starting to fill the ramekins.

goals.description: Fill the ramekins with chocolate mixture
goals.rationale: The person spoons the chocolate mixture into the ramekins and checks the fill level.

goals.description: Clean the utensils and scrape down the bowl
goals.rationale: The person licks the spoon, scrapes down the sides of the bowl with the spatula, licks the spatula, and places the dirty utensils aside.

goals.description: Place the ramekins in the oven to bake
goals.rationale: The person opens the oven, adjusts the shelf, and places both filled ramekins inside to bake.

goals.description: Prepare plates for serving the puddings
goals.rationale: The person retrieves plates from the shelf and places them on the counter to serve the puddings.

goals.description: Remove the baked puddings from the oven
goals.rationale: The person uses oven gloves to take the hot ramekins out of the oven and places them on the counter.

goals.description: Unmold the first pudding onto a plate
goals.rationale: The person loosens the pudding with a knife, places a plate on top, flips it over using a towel, and removes the hot ramekin.

goals.description: Unmold the second pudding onto a plate
goals.rationale: The person loosens the second pudding, flips it onto a plate using a towel, and removes the ramekin to serve.
